name: Android2Rust Management & Forensics Console
description: 100% pure-Rust native Win32 (WinSafe) & cross-platform Iced ADB/Fastboot GUI wrapper, device orchestrator, offline Android forensics workstation, CLI, and MCP server.
majorCapabilities: ADB & Fastboot command builder, parser, and live streaming runner
Offline DFIR forensics (.apk AXML/ABX0, bugreport.zip, encrypted .ab PBKDF2/AES-256-CBC, SQLite .db)
Dual SHA-256 + SHA-512 chain-of-custody & timeline CSV/JSONL exports
13-tool MCP JSON-RPC stdio server with destructive safety guards

tools.summary: Detect host OS, adb and fastboot binary availability, versions, and configuration directory.
List all 8 built-in ADB, Fastboot, and offline Android forensic inspection presets.
Build a validated ADB/Fastboot/Forensics command line plus optional .a2r, .bat, .ps1, .sh, and schtasks commands.
Parse a raw adb/fastboot command line or an .a2r recipe file path into a structured AndroidJob and validation diagnostics.
Decode an Android/ADB/Fastboot exit code or status string (e.g., INSTALL_FAILED_*, DEVICE_UNAUTHORIZED, FASTBOOT_LOCKED).
Manage saved persistent Android2Rust job profiles (list, get, save, delete).
Run pure-Rust offline forensic inspection on a local .apk, .ab (optionally decrypted), SQLite .db, ABX, bugreport .zip, XML, directory, or log dump.
Run a safe non-destructive pre-flight simulation (plus local artifact verification) without modifying connected Android devices.
Execute an ADB, Fastboot, or forensic job. Refuses destructive operations (flash, erase, format, unlock, uninstall, restore) unless confirm_destructive is true.
Generate an air-gapped offline HTML, JSON, Markdown, or timeline audit report from an artifact, log file, or dry-run job.
Search files across connected WPD/MTP devices or an offline synthetic directory fixture by wildcard/regex, size, date range, MIME/extension, with optional path-safe copy_out and Merkle-signed export.
Delete an object on a connected WPD/MTP device. Mutating operation: requires AllowMutating policy and confirm_destructive=true.
Enumerate connected Windows Portable Devices (WPD/MTP) or an offline synthetic directory fixture and their storages.
